views.tabTitle: Double-click or F2 renames the view
views.closeTitle: Close view – its tabs move to the neighboring view

layout.missingConnection: The workspace refers to a missing connection.
layout.tooManyPanes: A workspace can contain at most four terminal panes.
layout.tooManySessions: A workspace can start at most {{max}} sessions.

panel.copyFailed: The selected text could not be copied.
panel.pasteFailed: The clipboard could not be pasted.

input.multiline: Multi-line command: copy it line by line.
input.notConnected: The terminal is not connected; the command was not typed.
input.fullscreen: A full-screen program is running in the terminal; the command was not typed.
input.failed: The command could not be typed.

rdp.hiddenWhileMenu: Remote desktop hidden while a menu is open.

area.label: Terminal panes
area.emptyHint: Open a connection from the list or drop a tab here.
area.openFilesAria: Open files of this SSH connection in pane {{number}}
area.sendKeysAria: Send key combination to remote desktop in pane {{number}}

layoutMenu.label: Layout by keyboard
layoutMenu.dragHint: Drag a tab or an empty part of the title bar. Split at an edge, merge in the middle, or insert between tabs.
layoutMenu.resizeHint: Drag the dividers, or focus them and move them with the arrow keys. Drag tabs onto a view above to move them there.

timeline.title: Connecting to {{name}}…
timeline.waitingHostKey: Waiting for you to confirm the server key…
timeline.slowServer: The server is slow to respond…

auth.title: Sign-in rejected
auth.body: The server did not accept the sign-in.
auth.bodyWithUser: The server did not accept the sign-in as “{{user}}”.
auth.next: Check the user and sign-in method in the connection settings.

timeout.title: Server not responding
timeout.next: Check VPN, firewall and port. The machine may be off.

hostkey-changed.title: Server key has changed
hostkey-changed.body: The fingerprint does not match the confirmed one. Shellherd aborted the connection.
hostkey-changed.next: Clarify the key change with the administrator before you continue.

hostkey-rejected.title: Server key not confirmed
hostkey-rejected.body: You did not confirm the key of {{hostPort}}.
hostkey-rejected.next: Connect again and compare the fingerprint with a trusted source.

hostkey-store.title: Server key not checked
hostkey-store.body: The stored server keys are not available.
hostkey-store.next: Check the permissions on the Shellherd data folder and connect again.

refused.title: Connection refused
refused.bodyWithPort: {{host}} does not accept connections on port {{port}}.
refused.next: Check host and port. Is the SSH service running?

not-found.title: Host not found
not-found.body: The name “{{host}}” could not be resolved.
not-found.next: Check the spelling, DNS and VPN.

key-file.title: Key file not readable
key-file.body: The private key file is missing or not readable.
key-file.next: Check the path and permissions in the connection settings.

agent.title: No SSH agent
agent.body: No SSH agent is running that could supply the key.
agent.next: Start the agent or choose password or key file.

closed-by-server.title: Connection ended
closed-by-server.next: Reconnect when you want to keep working.

idle.title: Disconnected while idle
idle.body: Shellherd ended the connection after the configured idle time.
idle.next: Reconnect or change the idle disconnect in the settings.
